Balances.description: Which balance-sheet amounts the ratios use (SPEC-0007 R2). No default: the analyst chooses.

oneOf.description: Balances at the end of the period (`closing`).
Average of the opening and closing balances: (opening + closing) / 2. Needs `opening`.

DebtPeriod.description: One period of the loan schedule.

cfads.description: Cash flow available for debt service in the period, in currency units.

debt_service.description: Debt service (principal and interest) due in the period, in currency units.

DebtSchedule.description: The loan schedule from the calculation date to the final maturity.

debt_outstanding.description: Debt outstanding at the start of the first period, in currency units.

discount_rate.description:
Discount rate for the LLCR: the cost of debt per period of the schedule chosen by the
analyst, as a decimal fraction (0.06 = 6% per period).

periods.description: Periods 1..n, in order, up to the final maturity of the loan. At least one.

reserve_balance.description:
Balance of the debt service reserve account at the valuation date, in currency units,
added undiscounted to the LLCR numerator. Absent: no reserve account.

net_financial_position.description: Net financial position with its composition, in currency units.

DebtServiceIncome.description: Flows of the period, in currency units.

ebit.description: EBIT (operating result) of the period, in currency units.

ebitda.description: EBITDA of the period, in currency units, as defined in `ebitda_definition`.

interest.description:
Interest expense of the period, in currency units, as defined in `interest_definition`
(gross, or net of interest income).

NetFinancialPosition.description:
The net financial position with its composition (SPEC-0007 R6). Fairmark adds what is
given and does not choose which items are included.

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents, in currency units, subtracted from the gross debt.

gross_debt.description: Gross financial debt (bank loans, bonds and other borrowings), in currency units.

other_items.description: Other items included by the analyst, each added with its sign. Default: none.

NfpItem.description: One item of the net financial position other than gross debt and cash.

amount.description:
Amount in currency units, added to the net financial position: positive for debt-like
items, negative for financial assets.

name.description: What the item is, for example "lease liabilities" or "derivative assets".

balances.description: Balances used by the ratios: `closing`, or `average` of opening and closing.

closing.description: Balance sheet at the end of the period.

debt_schedule.description:
Loan schedule for DSCR and LLCR. Absent: DSCR and LLCR are not defined and the other
ratios are computed.

ebitda_definition.description:
How EBITDA was measured, in words (for example "reported EBITDA, no adjustments");
echoed in the conventions.

interest_definition.description:
How interest was measured, in words (for example "gross interest expense" or "interest
expense net of interest income"); echoed in the conventions.

opening.description:
Balance sheet at the start of the period. Required with average balances; not used
with closing balances.
